title: Compress Extension
description: Compression metadata for Earth observation and environmental data.

compress:mode.description: Fidelity mode of the compressed representation.

compress:codec_version.description: Version of the codec or algorithm.

compress:configuration.description: Name or identifier of the complete codec configuration.

compress:objective.description: Trade-off prioritized by the compression configuration.

compress:parameters.description: Codec-specific options used to produce the compressed representation.

compress:error_bound.description: Maximum absolute error in near-lossless mode or maximum RMSE in lossy mode.

compress:error_bound_unit.description: Native unit of the error bound.

compress:nodata_preserved.description: Whether NoData positions are preserved and no new NoData values are introduced.

compress:zero_preserved.description: Whether exact zeros in native units are preserved.

compress:input_bytes.description: Size of the uncompressed input representation in bytes.

compress:compressed_bytes.description: Size of the compressed representation in bytes.

compress:compression_ratio.description: Input size divided by compressed size.

compress:bits_per_value.description: Compressed size in bits per input value.

compress:encode_time_seconds.description: Time to encode the representation in seconds.

compress:decode_time_seconds.description: Time to decode the representation in seconds.

compress:encode_throughput_mb_s.description: Encoding throughput in decimal megabytes per second.

compress:decode_throughput_mb_s.description: Decoding throughput in decimal megabytes per second.

compress:downstream_metrics.description: Named downstream task metrics measured on the compressed representation.
